member.name: M:PlantSafety.UI.Components.Layout.AppShell.InitializeSessionAsync
member.summary: Gates the app on a *silently* recoverable session only. AppShell never triggers an interactive MSAL prompt itself — that responsibility belongs exclusively to the dedicated Login page (see Volume AUTH1). When no cached credential is available, the user is redirected to /login instead of being blocked behind an error.
